'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Clayton Atkin LS Tatooine: Slave Quarters''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Clayton Atkin]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Tatooine: Slave Quarters]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
